authority: Order 009 single consolidated production-layout correction round

defects.observation: The global max-width rule clamps the accepted 2088px table to 894.5px at a 1280px viewport. Cells overlap and distribution plots shrink to 56px. A generic inherit rule also enlarges the accepted 10.5px explanatory text and 10px sample text to16px.
defects.correction: Restore the exact accepted intrinsic width, column proportions, 16px base, 10.5px explanation and 10px sample text. Keep horizontal overflow inside the focusable table region. No accepted font size is changed.

defects.position: Editable Table S2, first full-page Word conversion
defects.observation: The complete mean ± SD strings survive exactly in OOXML but some are forcibly wrapped inside digits in the narrow site columns, particularly Kumasi and brightest10h rows.
defects.correction: Preserve Arial10pt numeric font and the frozen14-column width vector. Give numeric cells 0.5pt side padding and apply 0.5pt condensed character spacing only to the complete mean ± SD runs. This is native Word run spacing, not a font-size reduction, raster scaling or value change. Check every resulting page and all170units.

defects.observation: The initial invocation exited before assembly because the archived PROSPECTIVE-only __main__ stop was inadvertently retained. No main DOCX was written.
defects.correction: Replace that obsolete stop with the current guarded main entrypoint, retaining all source, scope, author, part-count, figure, relationship and orientation checks. Retain the failed command record.

defects.observation: Two copied stylesheets share a non-interactive unreferenced order007-column-layout ID. Reader IDs and links remain unique.
defects.correction: Give the S2 stylesheet its own unique candidate-local ID. No selector, content or external source changes.

defects.observation: At2200px the page-start grid keeps tables within894.5px although the left margin leaves499.5px available. The1320px main Table2 consequently needs scrolling even at that desktop width.
defects.correction: Let existing wide table containers extend to the screen-start-inset grid line while ending at body-content-end, preserving the table-of-contents margin and normal prose measure. Keep intrinsic table widths and contained scrolling where the complete table remains wider than the available page.
